visualNotes.finding: Visible dark gap separates the small head loop from the main body; the primary/high graph has two disjoint cycles. The magenta uncertain edge would bridge this gap at the low threshold, making a one-stroke answer. The source image supports retaining the primary separation; sensitivity does not prove a real bridge.

limitations: Validation proves properties of supplied lattice graphs, not exact topology hidden by blur, yellow line thickness, red halo or camera registration.
Unused lattice nodes are grid placeholders, not observed isolated points. Edge-connected components determine strokes.
Degree-four crossing counts refer to four cardinal centerline arms meeting at one supplied vertex; they do not infer over/under or path order from photographs.

definitions.junctions: J: distinct supplied vertices of degree at least 3; includes degree-3 endpoint contact in a single Euler path
definitions.crossings: X: degree-4 vertices with two opposite tangent pairs; subset of J
definitions.repeatedPoints: For a single edge-once Euler path/circuit J equals the number of geometric points visited more than once when the closure cut duplicate is excluded. This assumes all geometric contacts are split into shared vertices.
